_doc: CPU quarterback and play-caller for interactive CPU drives (play/qbAI.ts). Times in seconds. openMargin: seconds a receiver must beat the closest defender by before the QB throws to him; readNoise: error (s) judging a window. Difficulty cpuOffense sets accuracy: release error = chargeSigma / cpuOffense^2 (sweet spot half-width is 0.09). slotBias: seconds added to a receiver's read (Phase 3b: outside receivers first, so the corners see realistic target volume); checkdownAfter: the RB is only read after this time unless the QB is pressured.
